title: Hearty Light German King Prawns Skewers
description: A light and adventurous German dish featuring king prawns, this recipe is perfect for those looking for a sugar-free and flavorful meal. The briny taste of the prawns pairs well with the bold flavors of the German-inspired seasonings.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a mortar, pound the garlic and onion until well combined.
Add the caraway seeds, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the mortar and pound until the mixture is well combined.
Thread the king prawns onto skewers.
Brush the prawns with olive oil and lemon juice.
Sprinkle the prawn skewers with the garlic and spice mixture.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
